audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 at 54.76% WR over 924 games — TF dominates the early lane (ASol among the weakest early laners), ASol out-scales from first item onward. Prose already frames it as win-early-or-lose.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content and packet: rows 0-2 and 4 read 'Skill' and row 3 read 'Aurelion Sol' while content win[0-4] and the packet chart all say Twisted Fate. phases[4].why also cited a 130-second Destiny timer; the kit says 170/140/110.
audit.why: Content and packet agree, so full sides were edited alone per the chart rule, with whys and ratings rewritten in the same group.
audit.corrected: phases[0-4].side -> Twisted Fate, whys grounded in ASol's weak early game and stack denial, Destiny CD corrected to 170s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: zero cooldown-sequencing advice and no digits in breakdown.cooldowns. Missing interactions: TF's gold card stun cancels ASol's channels (Breath of Light and Astral Flight are both channels), Singularity executes below a threshold, and Singularity's percent-health damage means resist stacking is not the answer.
audit.why: Kit numbers: Astral Flight 22s rank 1 / 16 max, Singularity 12s, Falling Star 120/110/100, TF W 6s, TF Q 6s. Channel flag on ASol Q and W confirms any CC cancels them.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now carries 22/16, 12s and 6s plus the channel-cancel line; Do's bullet rewritten to state the gold-card interrupt; Don'ts bleed replaced with the first-item scaling reason.

edits.before: Aurelion Sol wins by landing Astral Flight, denying your pattern, and out-ranging your plan one polite trade at a time.
edits.after: Aurelion Sol wins by farming Stardust safely, surviving to first item, then out-ranging you with a 750-range Q you can't answer.

edits.before: Q-farm from range and concede the duel question entirely — your level 1 is a wallet, not a weapon.
edits.after: ASol's level 1 is among the weakest in mid — walk up, auto, Q-farm; he has no answer before his stacks.

edits.before: W online: the gold card re-prices his every step-up. Lock yellow when he walks forward and the lane behaves.
edits.after: Gold card re-prices his every step-up, and his 22-second Astral Flight is his only out — shove and chip him.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit against no kit: stacked-deck autos beat his short Q channel, and your push starves the Stardust farm.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — keep crashing waves; every stack he misses under tower is scaling he never gets back.

edits.before: Destiny online — THE level in this lane. Every shove is now a bot-lane death sentence with a 130-second timer.
edits.after: Destiny online while his all-in is still absent — every shove is a bot-lane death sentence on a 170s timer.

edits.before: - Aurelion Sol Astral Flight: matchup-defining — His reposition and escape — he is a stationary battery while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W gold card like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Astral Flight: 22s at rank 1, 16 at max — he is a stationary battery while it is down; read it like a second minimap. - Singularity: 12s, and it executes below a threshold — leave the zone early. - Your W is 6s: a locked gold card cancels his Q channel outright.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Gold card interrupts his channels: the stun cancels Breath of Light and knocks him out of Astral Flight mid-flight.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: The map is your win condition — ASol scales past you at first item, and mid waves pay nothing once he clears from 750 range.

notes: Chart: content win[] already matched the packet (TF rows 0-4, ASol rows 5-6), so full sides were edited alone — no win[N] no-ops. phases[3] was the one true full/content disagreement (ASol vs Twisted Fate); moved to TF with why rewritten, rating 6/10 left as-is since it already read TF-favoured. phases[4] Destiny CD corrected 130s -> 170s rank 1 per kit. Missing interaction 'resistances-invalidated / percent-health on Singularity' was folded into the audit but no itemization edit was written: report[8].t is generic TF boilerplate and asserting an MR-vs-ASol claim beyond the kit flag risked magnitude-without-source. sectionsMissing (templated, not grounded): tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead, breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, breakdown.feeding, dosFull[0].d (Astral Flight body under a Q-farm title — mild mismatch, not lint-flagged, left to stay within the two-report/rewrite budget).
